rules.step_1: Tap a crystal vial to lift it, then tap another vial to pour matching top elixir layers.
rules.step_2: Pour onto the same top color or into an empty vial (max 4 units). Single-color vials stay put instead of moving to an empty vial.
rules.step_3: Fill a vial with 4 matching units to seal it with a cat-ear cork! Seal every color to deliver the order.
